name: xTerm Web Terminal
tagline: A fully functional terminal in your browser powered by xterm.js
description: Web-based terminal emulator using xterm.js with local command execution, file system simulation, and SSH-like experience. Practice Linux commands, navigate virtual file systems, and learn terminal skills without installing anything.
features: Full xterm.js integration with WebSocket support
50+ built-in commands (ls, cd, cat, grep, find, etc.)
Command history with arrow key navigation
Tab completion for commands and paths
target_audience: Beginners learning Linux/terminal, developers testing commands, educators
